paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Efficient deployment methods dramatically reduce the time cost. The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the comparison of two deployment methods, “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment,” based on their associated time costs. The chart contains two slices: “Reduction,” colored orange, represents approximately 69.92% of the total, and “Efficient deployment” is colored blue and represents approximately 30.08%. A percentage label, indicating 26.2s (30.08%), is displayed within the “Efficient deployment” slice, and a percentage label, indicating 60.9s (69.92%), is displayed within the “Reduction” slice. The slices appear to be ordered in descending size, with “Reduction” occupying the larger portion of the circle. A legend is not explicitly included, but percentage labels are provided within each slice.
